chunks: From him, from Ismail ibn Mihran, from Sayf ibn 'Amira, from 'Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Whoever from the Muslims has two children who precede him (to the next life), they will be reckoned in the Presence of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, as a veil for him from the Fire, by the Permission of Allah, the Exalted.

key_terms.قَدَّمَ: To precede or go before (in death)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of losing two children in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) emphasizes the unique intercessory role of children, where the loss of two serves as a spiritual shield (hijab) against the Hellfire. This concept is often contextualized within the broader theological discussion of *hazirat* (sorrow) as a means of expiation for sins, reflecting the mercy of Allah in transforming personal grief into eternal salvation.
